messages:
anika-partnerships: APAC SI asked for a single marketplace private-offer that bundles a 12-month reserved commit + 3% hardware rebate on appliances. They also want an auto-renew protection clause (no cliff discount drops) and an optional conversion credit if usage ramps beyond commit. Can we scope constraints and a safe pricing band?

mike-sales: Key asks: 1) single-looking SKU that shows software commit + hardware rebate, 2) 30d auto-renew protection window, 3) conversion credit up to 20% of Q1 overage applied as future credit.

sarah-ops: Marketplace note: UI can present a bundle but backend will be two SKUs (metered commit + hw rebate). Many marketplaces reject negative-line items in sandbox. Need to validate auto-renew semantics too.

anika-partnerships: Options: Plan A = composite UI SKU mapping to two backend SKUs. Plan B = two private offers + partner-facing bundle sheet. Which to prototype?

josh-product: Prototype Plan A, keep Plan B as fallback. Requirements for Plan A: SKU mapping rules, renewal guardrails, conversion credit flow.

```
# example mapping
bundle_sku: REDW-BNDL-APAC-12
maps_to: REDW-COMMIT-12 (metered)
          REDW-HW-VOUCHER (post-provision voucher)
renewal_guard: 30d lock where pricing cannot drop >5% unless requested
conversion_credit: up to 20% of Q1 overage, issued as voucher, expires 90d
```

josh-product: Also: if partner upgrades early, prorate conversion credit to immediate invoice credit.

mike-sales: Commercial guardrails: cap hw rebate at $200k/account, require serials + install proof to redeem.

sarah-ops: Ops checklist:
- verify marketplace supports vouchers/negative line fallback
- test dual-SKU mapping in billing sandbox
- webhook to mint conversion-credit vouchers tagged "conversion-credit"

marketplace-bot: private-offer-validator: sandbox reject detected for REDW-BNDL-APAC-12: negative price on hw SKU not allowed. Recommend voucher post-provision flow.

anika-partnerships: OK switch to voucher flow: bundle UI + backend creates commit SKU + issues voucher after install verification. Conversion credit becomes voucher too.

mike-sales: I'll draft partner T&Cs: voucher redemption steps, serial upload, 90d expiry, $200k cap, renew protection 30d, conversion credit terms. Pinging legal.

sarah-ops: Timeline: voucher flow prototyping is ~2 sprints (billing integration + UI). Negative-line item approach adds marketplace approvals (4+ weeks).

anika-partnerships: Actions: @mike-sales draft terms by EOD Wed, @sarah-ops start sandbox tests for mapping + voucher path, @josh-product create product brief and UI mock for bundle SKU. I'll sync with SI next Tue to confirm install verification checklist. :thumbsup:
